message: Type Version is not defined. x-fern-global-headers type 'Version' references it, but it is neither a Fern primitive nor a key of components.schemas, so Fern treats it as unknown.
x-fern-global-headers type 'map<Tag, string>' uses 'Tag' as a map key, but map keys must be primitive types; Fern ignores this type and falls back to string.
Type Key is not defined. x-fern-idempotency-headers type 'optional<Key>' references it, but it is neither a Fern primitive nor a key of components.schemas, so Fern treats it as unknown.
